name: newrelic
title: New Relic
description: Observability and alerting: run NRQL queries, inspect APM applications, manage alert policies and conditions, dashboards, synthetic monitors, and deployment markers via the New Relic NerdGraph and REST APIs.

api_key.label: User API Key
api_key.help: User API key from New Relic → Profile → API Keys. Must be a User key (NRAK- prefix), not a license/ingest key.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.help: Your New Relic account ID, visible in the URL or under Account Settings.
